summary: @or-sdk/store 2.1.6 executes obfuscated payload via bundled Bun runtime at npm install
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, extracts and chmod +x's the binary to a temp directory, then invokes it against the shipped `math_init.js` — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle using a rotated numeric constants table and array-shuffle function (obfuscator.io-style transforms). The dropper file `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-mangled identifiers. The obfuscated payload's filename (`math_init.js`) does not correspond to the advertised functionality of `@or-sdk/store` (a small key-value store client that lives in `dist/`), and executing it through a freshly downloaded alternate interpreter bypasses standard Node-based inspection. The package name also mirrors an internal onereach.io SDK referenced in the CHANGELOG (`gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next`), consistent with a dependency-confusion vector against organizations depending on the internal SDK.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
